method.execution: Source inspection and Git tree/blob identity comparison only; no new engine, native, test, capture, or performance execution for this review.
method.identity: Blob IDs are Git object IDs for whole files at the two commits; null means the path is absent at that commit. Equality of selected blobs does not establish equality of all runtime inputs; inequality does not by itself prove a semantic change.
method.historical_boundary: Original audit witnesses and 2026-11-09 remediation receipts are historical, with their own source/configuration/platform limits. In particular flight_session.gd differs, so old full-tick numerical results are not current measurements.
method.validation_boundary: Software regression, numerical consistency, real-hardware performance, rendered inspection and physical aircraft validation are distinct claims.

findings.title: Extra 300S spanwise progression and reverse-flow seam
findings.status_scope: The original finite seam from scaling the physical reverse-flow angle is addressed. This is numerical continuity and consumer agreement, not physical aircraft validation; a small Godot wrapf endpoint residual remains.
findings.current_source: The force and wake paths pass the physical angle separately from the strip factor. WingPolar retains progressed stall through 45 degrees, blends toward the physical-angle law through 90 degrees, and uses that law in reverse flow. The native mirror follows the same continuation.

findings.title: Statistics lock JSON integer and stale-lock recovery
findings.status_scope: Integral JSON floats are accepted for new version-2 leases, subject to conservative ownership checks. Old three-field lock records and unsupported, foreign, or ambiguous scopes deliberately remain read-only and are not automatically reclaimed.
findings.current_source: A qualified lease requires matching host/namespace scope, bindable UDP port, verified absent process and stable record/directory. _lock_integer accepts finite integral int or float; legacy records do not satisfy the version-2 format.

source_refs.symbol: cross-process cases conditional on qualified scope
historical Linux and Windows checked lock receipts

findings.retained_remediation_evidence: The 2026-11-09 checked index records complete passing Linux and Windows invocations of test_flight_statistics_lock.gd. Its cross-process cases skip when no qualified scope is available, so receipt success alone does not prove that branch ran on every platform.

historical_witness.scope: Historical audit at the original commit; not a new execution.

findings.next_check: Run the checked lock test on each qualified native OS and explicitly decide/document the support or migration policy for valid stale pre-upgrade records.

findings.title: Optional resources loaded before feature selection
findings.status_scope: The named early-load cases were moved behind their feature paths. The complete preload graph, actual incremental residency and startup impact are not established.
findings.current_source: RC dirt/grass texture paths load in configure and the track view after the empty-track guard; lake audio and Ugly Stik engine assets load on selected use. A selected ground scene still preloads effects modules before the effect-enable decision, and both modules preload a shared smoke texture.
findings.retained_remediation_evidence: The 2026-11-09 checked index records a complete passing Windows invocation of test_optional_resource_loading.gd. The old isolated 21.66 MiB headless static-memory increment includes dependencies and is not a current saving, whole-app RSS, VRAM or GPU measurement.
findings.next_check: Run the two focused checked tests; inspect fresh-process off/on activity dependency and cache behavior before matched cold/warm startup, peak/retained memory and hitch measurements on representative hardware.

findings.title: Cloud layer seed and shadow-cache binding mismatch
findings.status_scope: The original derived-layer versus base-seed mismatch is corrected in source. Synthetic binding tests and historical checked receipts do not prove GPU bake, displayed parity, or performance across all presets.
findings.current_source: Atmosphere requests eligible layer seeds; the cache binds distinct seeds into up to four slots and the shader selects matching seeds with analytic fallback. Cirrus, anvil and zero-coverage/density layers are excluded.

source_refs.symbol: eligible layer and synthetic binding checks

findings.retained_remediation_evidence: The 2026-11-09 checked index records complete passing Windows invocations of test_sky_relief_layers.gd, test_cloud_shadow_map.gd and test_cloud_cache_disable.gd. The old base/derived seed values and six-preset witness apply to the original fixture.
findings.separate_caveat: A direct cloudy-preset or seed transition may leave old tiles occupying the four slots while a consumer remains, forcing new eligible layers to analytic fallback. This is separately tracked and is not the repaired original seed mismatch.

historical_witness.scope: Historical audit at the original commit; not a new execution.

findings.next_check: Run the three checked tests, exercise direct cloudy-to-cloudy transitions with live consumers and stale completions, and use native 1080p captures/performance before making GPU claims.

findings.title: Swept lake positive-down slope normal has reversed horizontal signs
findings.status_scope: The swept bank and water event helper uses the wrong horizontal signs; the separate soft-hull helper already uses the correct convention and does not repair the swept path. Historical full-tick numbers are not current measurements.
findings.current_source: For down-height D=h(N,E), the outward unit normal is [h_N,h_E,-1]/length. LakeCollision._surface_normal returns [-h_N,-h_E,-1]/length, so its vector is not orthogonal to the surface tangent when a slope is nonzero. Bank impact speed and effective mass feed the terminal decision; water event kinematics are affected as well.
findings.retained_remediation_evidence: No current fix is present in the swept helper. Its lake_collision.gd blob, lake_surface.gd and hull_contact.gd blobs match the original audit; flight_session.gd differs, so that equality cannot establish the current integrated outcome.

historical_witness.scope: Historical audit at the original commit; not a new execution.

findings.next_check: Use an analytic positive-down plane/tangent oracle for the swept normal, both slope signs and water/bank cases; if desired, rerun the historical full-session witness and sign-only control on isolated copies of the current snapshot.

findings.title: Swept bank ignores X99 model-specific crash tolerance
findings.status_scope: The swept path ignores both configured model-specific energy and depth thresholds and uses shared defaults. The historical controlled full tick isolates the energy mismatch; the depth mismatch needs a separate case.
findings.current_source: X99 authors estimated 12.5 J/kg and 0.12 m; session hull preparation stores those values. Both sampled and non-sampled lake sweeps omit that prepared tolerance and use shared 2.5 J/kg and 0.08 m constants for bank decisions.

source_refs.symbol: shared defaults and prepared tolerance accessors
prepared hull tolerance and flat touchdown

findings.retained_remediation_evidence: No current swept-tolerance correction is present. Original and current lake collision, hull contact and X99 data blobs match; flight_session.gd differs. The X99 thresholds are estimates and owner drop tests remain pending.

historical_witness.scope: Historical audit at the original commit; not a new execution.

findings.historical_control_limit: The threshold-only diagnostic changes 2.5 to 12.5 J/kg; it does not change 0.08 to 0.12 m and therefore does not experimentally demonstrate the depth branch.
findings.next_check: Cover values around both thresholds with tolerant and default aircraft, near-boundary and deep-crush cases, and sampled/non-sampled paths. Run any historical negative controls only in isolated copies.

findings.title: Repeated statistics snapshot quarantine blocks future writes
findings.status_scope: A fixed per-slot quarantine filename makes a subsequent recovery fail closed when that filename already exists, even with a valid alternate snapshot and an owned writer lock.
findings.current_source: _read_snapshots records invalid slots; _quarantine_bad_snapshots immediately rejects an existing slot quarantine; open then marks the store read-only and commit refuses writes. This covers immediate reopen after a first recovery and another corruption of the same slot after healthy alternating commits.

source_refs.symbol: recovery chooses snapshot and assigns writability

findings.retained_remediation_evidence: The 2026-11-09 checked index records a passing Windows invocation of the existing statistics-store test, but its stated single-corruption and separate deletion cases do not cover same-slot repeated recovery. The production store blob changed since the historical audit, so the old probe is not a current execution.

historical_witness.scope: Historical audit at the original commit; not a new execution.

findings.next_check: Test initial corrupt/recover and immediate reopen; separately perform healthy commits and re-corrupt the same slot, preserving distinct and identical bad bytes, history, lock ownership and writability, then test commit/deletion and write failures.

related_observations.scope: At zero intensity some source/cloud/skyline work appears to proceed. The 600 samples/frame setting budgets job sampling, but whole mesh-chunk preparation can occur before that budget is applied; it does not bound total per-callback work. No timing bottleneck has been measured. Profile a matched full scene before prioritizing changes and preserve other state contracts.
